subject: Justin Tseng City Council Candidacy
overview: Justin Tseng announced his candidacy for the Medford City Council. He outlined a platform centered on progressive structural change, school funding, and racial justice.

items.title: Candidacy Announcement
items.summary: Justin Tseng declared his candidacy for City Council, citing his upbringing in Medford and calling for a city government that prioritizes school funding, climate action, and racial justice.
